text: Nothing but the sound of water finding its way down.
Shapes drop from a crack in the ceiling.
The ceiling gives way behind you.
A pocket of stale air burns in every throat.
A dead adventurer's pack, still buckled shut.
A trickle of water that does not smell of rot.
The passage doubles back. Time lost, nerves worse.
Something takes hold of the rearmost boot.
A niche shrine, its offering bowl unlooted.
A short halt. It is not rest, but it is something.
A horn sounds somewhere below. It is answered.
Coins scattered where someone dropped everything and ran.
